messages:
Riley M: Noticing an uptick in fncall validation rejections hitting the fallback path in ap-south around 13:03 UTC. small volume but persistent from one customer org.
Priya S: I see the same on the regional dashboard. Rejections spike correlates with tool_output shape errors.
Noah T: Ping the snippet if you have one. Array vs object again?
Riley M: Example (sanitized):
```json
{"session":"s_abc","tool_output":{"items":[{"msg":"ok"}]}}
```
Riley M: But our model variant sometimes emits `tool_output` as an array: `[{...}]` which fails the strict schema.
Priya S: That explains it. Current gate is strict for fncall on prod. Fallbacks route to degen which counts as a full fncall cost. Ops flagged billing.
DevOps-bot: Alert triggered: fncall_validation_rejects_ap-south > 2% (last 10m). See https://console/redwood/alerts/9123
Ivy Z: Can we temporarily soften the gate for that customer org only? We have the per-account feature flag but it's not exposed in console yet.
Noah T: We can flip a runtime flag under /flags/customer/{org_id}/validation_soft=true. Low risk. But need to ensure we tag these requests so billing is clear.
Priya S: Also request: increase sampling for validation failures from 1% to 10% for that org for 1h. Need full payloads + model_decodes for postmortem.
Riley M: I'll trigger sampling bump and add a dashboard panel showing recent mismatch diffs. Prefer redacted examples.
Ivy Z: Can we add a new telemetry dimension validation_outcome with values {hard_reject, soft_coerce, auto_fix} so we don't lump everything as fallback? ops really needs that.
Noah T: Adding metric is fine but will take a deploy. Short-term we can emit a tag on traces: validation_kind=hard|coerce.
Finance-bot: FYI we saw two chargeback tickets where degen fallbacks billed at full unit price — finance requesting discount rule if fallback != executed_tool.
Priya S: Proposed emergency steps: 1) flip per-org soft-validate for org_x for 2h; 2) bump sampling to 10% for failing requests for same org; 3) add trace tag route_override=soft-validate; 4) create console widget surfacing top-3 mismatches (redacted).
Noah T: I'll implement 1 & 3 now. Will run a quick smoke test.
Riley M: Thanks. Smoke: after flip, fallback events from org_x dropped from 18 -> 1 in 12m.
Ivy Z: I'll open a small RFC to define billing semantics for graceful fallback vs hard reject. Link in thread when ready.
Priya S: Postmortem action: update SDK docs to clearly show tool_output union, add serializer helpers, and add telemetry split. Also schedule a canary to move default for new canary region to soft-validate for 2 weeks.
Noah T: Patch PR: https://git/redwood/pulls/4301 (runtime flag + trace tagging).
Riley M: Leaving this open for 1h to monitor, then we'll revert the flag if all good. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
